description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Xin Zhao's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] and ''[[File:Xin Zhao Audacious Charge.png|20xpx|border|link=Xin Zhao#Audacious Charge|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Audacious Charge]] [[Xin Zhao#Audacious Charge|Audacious Charge]]'' apply the ''[[File:Xin Zhao Challenged.png|20xpx|link=Xin Zhao#Challenged|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Challenged]] [[Xin Zhao#Challenged|Challenged]]'' mark to enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] hit, with the latter applying the mark to the farthest champion hit in the area of effect or the primary target if they are a champion.
description.text: Passive: Xin Zhao's basic attacks and Audacious Charge apply the Challenged mark to enemy champions hit, with the latter applying the mark to the farthest champion hit in the area of effect or the primary target if they are a champion.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Xin Zhao''' sweeps his spear around him, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies, capped at 600 against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking back]] all targets hit that are not ''[[File:Xin Zhao Challenged.png|20xpx|link=Xin Zhao#Challenged|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Challenged]] [[Xin Zhao#Challenged|Challenged]]'' up-to 700 units over 0.75 seconds, as well as [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunning]] them for the same duration.
description2.text: Active: Xin Zhao sweeps his spear around him, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies, capped at 600 against minions and monsters, and knocking back all targets hit that are not Challenged up-to 700 units over 0.75 seconds, as well as stunning them for the same duration.

description3.raw: For the next 4 seconds, '''Xin Zhao''' is [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]] against enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] far away from him.
description3.text: For the next 4 seconds, Xin Zhao is invulnerable against enemy champions far away from him.

75 / 125 / 175 / 225 / 275 (+ 100% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 110% AP) (+ 15% of target's '''current''' health)
leveling2.text: Physical Damage:75 / 125 / 175 / 225 / 275 (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 110% AP) (+ 15% of target's current health)

notes.raw: * [[File:Summon Tibbers.png|20px|link=Pets|An icon representing the keyword Pet]] [[:Pets|Pets]], [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|traps]], [[File:Eye of Destruction.png|20px|link=Location-targeted|An icon representing the keyword Location-targeted]] [[:Location-targeted|ground]] [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|AoEs]], [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|DoTs]], and delayed-damage abilities (e.g. [[File:Zed Death Mark.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark]] [[Zed#Death Mark|Death Mark]], [[File:Tristana Explosive Charge.png|20xpx|border|link=Tristana#Explosive Charge|An icon for Tristana's ability Explosive Charge]] [[Tristana#Explosive Charge|Explosive Charge]], [[File:Vladimir Hemoplague.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir#Hemoplague|An icon for Vladimir's ability Hemoplague]] [[Vladimir#Hemoplague|Hemoplague]]) will not damage '''Xin Zhao''' if the enemy champion source is outside the circle when the damage applies. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|Displacement immunity]] will also resist the application of the [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]].
notes.text:
Pets, traps, ground AoEs, DoTs, and delayed-damage abilities (e.g. Death Mark, Explosive Charge, Hemoplague) will not damage Xin Zhao if the enemy champion source is outside the circle when the damage applies.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Displacement immunity will also resist the application of the stun.
